body:
The KG-Microbe promotion review (#1123 upstream) found four remaining disagreements caused by differing chemical scope. Implement the user-authorized dispositions with complete-row review and retained source history:

- Keep generic Polymyxin B at NCIT:C61894 (B1/B2 mixture), with CAS 1404-26-8; keep B1/CAS 4135-11-9 and sulfate separate.
- Re-ground bare Rifamycin at CHEBI:26580. The original three MicrobeDecoder fields (BacDive 16969, 13220, 166282) do not specify SV. Preserve Rifamycin_Sv at CHEBI:29673 with CAS 6998-60-3. Family indexing must not infer activity against every member.
- Preserve the CAS-grounded Xanthine ingredient at CHEBI:17712 / CAS 69-89-6; generic traits use CHEBI:15318. Preserve the native parent relationship and document the accepted scope distinction.
- Replace Sorbitan Monooleate's label-only NCIT:C75654 grounding with kgmicrobe.ingredient:sorbitan_monooleate. Restore the missing membership links for CultureMech:008837 and CultureMech:008839 from the two archived source occurrences; retain their original 1 g/L descriptions. Hold molecular equivalence and CAS pending product evidence.

Implementation and source extracts are being added to #754. Mapping changes receive a new approval-free receipt followed by explicit, hash-bound complete-row decisions. The local Sorbitan exactMatch links two records for the same unresolved recipe material; it does not establish molecular identity. CAS values are annotations, not parent/member equivalence. Regenerate exports and verify actual downstream candidate routes. Production promotion remains coordinated through https://github.com/Knowledge-Graph-Hub/kg-microbe/issues/1123.
title: Apply reviewed Polymyxin B, Rifamycin, Xanthine and Sorbitan scope decisions
